title: New fingerprint readers from 1 December
body: We're replacing the card readers at the Malé office. Drop by HR this month to register your fingerprint. It takes two minutes.

title: Year end dinner, 17 December
body: Hulhumalé beach, 7 pm. Bring your family. Let HR know by 5 December how many are coming.

title: Visa renewals need 60 days
body: Immigration has been slow lately. If your visa or work permit expires in the next two months, send your documents to HR this week.
